|game_text=Deploy on [[Death Star: Conference Room (V){{!}}Conference Room]] (only at start of game); ▼ [[Sim Aloo]] here and [Virtual Block 4] There is No Try. |errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-theinnercircle-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-06-The_Inner_Circle.png]]). The later errata version is [[The Inner Circle (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Conference Room (only at start of game); ▼ Sim Aloo here and [Virtual Block 4] There is No Try. Players initiate battles here for free. Once per game may ▼ Ord Mantell. May not be canceled (except by opponent) or placed in Used Pile. Immune to Ineffective Maneuver.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-theinnercircle-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-06-The_Inner_Circle.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 32) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Inner Circle (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) wrote the ▼ out, changed “Players initiate battles” to “Players may initiate battle” and misspelled “Manuever” (as published)<ref name="cl-1281_13-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Deploy on Conference Room (only at start of game); deploy Sim Aloo here and [Virtual Block 4] There is No Try from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Players may initiate battle here for free. Once per game may deploy Ord Mantell from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May not be canceled (except by opponent) or placed in Used Pile. Immune to Ineffective Manuever.” (The capture of 21 July 2012 and the Virtual Master list (VMasterType, 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11) print “(only at start of game). Deploy Sim Aloo”; the Virtual Block 8 list from 12 December 2012 prints “; deploy”. That difference is punctuation and capitals only and waits for a ruling, so it is not a separate version.) No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-06-The_Inner_Circle-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
